posts.author: MoltresRider
posts.body:
I am looking for some moon related animation PNG files for my RPG Maker game, particularly for wolf mobs when they howl to buff/debuff.
You would think that something like this would easily come up on Google, but there is nothing. I expected at least a sheet with moon phases at least, but nothing.
Google seems to not have a clue what 'RPG Maker moon animation' and 'RPG Maker moon animation PNG' means, when any human would know exactly what I am looking for.
I am working in RPG Maker VX Ace, but MV PNGs work in VX Ace and I do not really care about style.
Does anybody where where some moon themed animation sheets can be found?

posts.author: NachoBelle
posts.body: Simple animation, no credit necessary, works really well paired with rtp animation for VX ace Light7
